scope: Actual November4 official V3 deployment and participant update, followed by portable offline review.
submissionProvenanceNote: The CLI labels its optional timestamp participant-supplied. This value was supplied by the participant operator from an actual author_pendingExtrinsics first observation matching this exact transaction hash, account and call; it is not a fabricated wallet-send timestamp.

offlineReview.trust: Offline RPC-supplied facts; source authenticity, current network and independent consensus are not verified

network.reason: Offline configured event-testnet genesis match; no current network verification

inclusion.reason: Submitted hash matches inclusion and indexed transaction

execution.reason: Successful execution correlated to exact inclusion

finality.reason: Linked ancestry from finalized block to exact inclusion

state.reason: Finalized readback context and uint64 sequence match

limits: Selected official-source RPC correlation, not independent consensus or trie/storage proof.
Reports preserve original times and stay offline on import.
Live probe collector has a32-parent-edge window; use the saved report for historical replay.
Failure/revert/fork cases in the six rehearsal catalog remain synthetic unless separately identified.
